edges.reason: withdraw iterates feesWallets to read each wallet address and fee percentage.
withdraw performs low-level call{value:} transfers whose success is not checked, enabling reentrant recipients.
withdraw computes (balance * feesWallets[i].fees) / 10000 for every fee wallet.
The remaining contract balance is sent to msg.sender through a low-level call.
Fee percentages read from feesWallets drive the payout division arithmetic.
reveal mixes block.timestamp into the keccak256 seed for startingIndex.
startingIndex is derived from miner-influenceable block values.
The pseudo-random result is written into startingIndex.
reveal sets isRevealed to true.
reveal stores the provided base url into _baseURIextended.
addFeesWallet reads feesWallets to sum existing percentages and later pushes a new entry.
addFeesWallet accumulates all fee percentages and requires the new total to stay below 10000.
The summation loop reads every feesWallets[i].fees value.
applyBuyToken enforces totalSupply + numberOfTokens <= MAX_SUPPLY.
applyBuyToken reads tokenPrice to compute the required payment.
tokenPrice * numberOfTokens is compared with msg.value.
applyBuyToken calls _safeMint in a loop, invoking onERC721Received on contract recipients before state settles.
Minted tokens of the public sale are assigned to msg.sender.
buyTokens requires saleIsActive before minting.
buyTokens caps numberOfTokens by MAX_PUBLIC_MINT_PER_TRANSACTION.
buyTokens delegates the minting logic to applyBuyToken.
buyPrivateTokens increments privateDropIndex for each private token.
buyPrivateTokens enforces privateDropIndex <= MAX_PRIVATE_SUPPLY.
buyPrivateTokens uses _safeMint, triggering external onERC721Received callbacks on contract recipients.
buyPrivateTokens derives token ids from totalSupply against the MAX_SUPPLY cap.
claimFreeTokens requires freeTokenIsActive.
claimFreeTokens checks and then sets freeClaimeds[msg.sender] to prevent repeated claims.
Free claim tracking is keyed on the untrusted msg.sender address.
claimFreeTokens validates the caller through verifyFreeSignature.
claimFreeTokens enforces the MAX_SUPPLY cap before minting.
claimFreeTokens mints with _safeMint inside a loop, allowing reentrant onERC721Received callbacks after freeClaimeds is set.
The free claim amount and recipient are bound to msg.sender.
verifyFreeSignature recovers the signer using ECDSA.recover.
The recovered address is compared against the privileged whiteListeSigner.
verifyFreeSignature obtains the signed digest from hashFreeSignature.
buyTokenWithWhiteList requires whitelistSaleIsActive.
buyTokenWithWhiteList caps minting by MAX_PUBLIC_MINT_PER_TRANSACTION_WHITELIST.
buyTokenWithWhiteList validates the caller through verifyWhitelistSignature.
buyTokenWithWhiteList delegates minting to applyBuyToken.
verifyWhitelistSignature recovers the signer using ECDSA.recover.
The recovered address is compared against the privileged whiteListeSigner.
verifyWhitelistSignature obtains the digest from hashWhitelisteSignature.
msg.sender is the wallet bound into the whitelist ticket and the mint recipient.
setTokenPrice writes the tokenPrice state variable.
setWhiteListSigner updates the trusted signer used by both signature checks.
freezeBaseUrl sets isBaseUrlFrozen permanently to true.
setUnrevealedURI writes the unrevealedTokenUri used before reveal.
setBaseURI writes the private _baseURIextended string.
setBaseURI reverts when isBaseUrlFrozen is true.
setSaleState toggles saleIsActive.
setFreeTokensState toggles freeTokenIsActive.
setWhitelisteSaleState toggles whitelistSaleIsActive.
tokenURI branches on isRevealed to choose metadata source.
tokenURI returns unrevealedTokenUri while the collection is unrevealed.
tokenURI offsets the token id by startingIndex.
tokenURI reduces the shuffled id modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
tokenURI obtains the base uri through the _baseURI hook.
_baseURI returns the stored _baseURIextended value.
The _safeMint path invokes the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook, an extension point for external logic.
